info.name: Lab 3 regression through Lab 4 broker
info.description: Existing 18-request Lab 2/3 stack regression, followed by broker health/metrics/error/envelope checks and one transport contract per configured service-to-service edge. Generated credentials remain runtime variables; never export secrets. Edge checks prove delivery to a target instance, not execution of the calling service HTTP client.
